review_evidence: Reviewed the exact source, elaborated signature, blind reconstruction, whole candidate module and lesson in the bound packet. The proof establishes progressiveness separately on each filtration window using its local measurable-space instance and joint continuity of c. A single bound for |c| on the compact product [0,T]×S holds for every sample. Joint measurability of X gives a measurable section at each fixed sample, so Integrable.of_bound proves the universal section assertion directly. The sample-first swap is measurable, and the time projection lifts the horizon support to the product almost everywhere. MemLp.of_bound applies on the finite product for the full ENNReal exponent range, including p=0 and p=∞. At T=0 the horizon measure is zero, so the endpoint case is included. The lesson's windows, horizon support, quantified sections and product estimate follow this proof. The canonical packet digest and exact UTF-8 hashes for source, elaborated statement, blind reconstruction and whole candidate Lean module all recomputed. The verified packet binds the reader text and publication-binding identifier. In the revised packet, the source and reader replace the raw evaluation notation in their prose with the coefficient evaluated along X and typeset the L^p notation. The exact b(t,ω)=c(t,X_t(ω)) formula, assumptions, proof, theorem and blind reconstruction agree with the prior packet. These wording changes preserve all seven semantic slots. The new source text hash also recomputes.

objects.original: A finite sample measure and filtration, compact-state process X, continuous scalar coefficient c and composite b(t,ω)=c(t,X_t(ω)).
objects.reconstructed: The same μ, filtration, X, c and b, with separate sample-first product representative.
objects.evidence: The Lean let b has exactly the stated evaluation. processFunction b is used with the measurable sample-first swap in the proof.

domains.original: Nonnegative real time, a compact second-countable pseudometrizable Borel state S, horizon measure restricted to [0,T], and product Ω×ℝ₊.
domains.reconstructed: NNReal time, the same compact pseudometrizable Borel state, TimeMeasure.upTo T and the sample-first μ⊗λ_T.
domains.evidence: The signature uses CompactSpace, PseudoMetrizableSpace, SecondCountableTopology and BorelSpace. The product proof explicitly changes the measure to μ.prod (TimeMeasure.upTo T).

quantifiers.original: For every finite nonnegative T and extended nonnegative p, and for every sample ω in the time-section assertion.
quantifiers.reconstructed: T:NNReal, p:ENNReal, and ∀ω for section integrability.
quantifiers.evidence: The Lean `intro ω` in the section proof is universal. Only the product bound is lifted through an almost-everywhere time-support statement.

assumptions.original: A finite sample measure, filtration, joint measurability and strong progressiveness of X, and joint continuity of c.
assumptions.reconstructed: IsFiniteMeasure μ, the same filtration and state structures, hX, hProgressive and hc.
assumptions.evidence: No sample-path continuity, positivity of T, restriction on p, or probability normalization is assumed. Finiteness of μ is the stated conjunction's premise and is used for the product result.

conclusion.original: Strong progressiveness of b, integrability of each time section, and L^p membership of its sample-first product representative.
conclusion.reconstructed: IsStronglyProgressive filtration b ∧ (∀ω, Integrable ...) ∧ MemLp (processFunction b) p (processTimeMeasure μ T).
conclusion.evidence: Each conjunct is implemented by the named composition, section bound and product bound in the lesson. L^0 is interpreted by MemLp at exponent zero, and p=∞ by its essential-bound case.

scopes.original: Progressiveness for each filtration window. Sections use horizon time only. The product uses μ⊗λ_T.
scopes.reconstructed: For each r the product window Iic r × Ω has its restricted time Borel structure and the filtration σ-algebra at r. Sections and product use TimeMeasure.upTo T.
scopes.evidence: The proof introduces the local instance filtration r before composing measurable maps. The progressiveness conclusion is global and is independent of the horizon cutoff.

constant_dependencies.original: A deterministic bound for the continuous coefficient on the compact time-state product. The statement asks for every p with no rate or fixed bound asserted.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: A real bound C obtained from the compact image, independent of ω and p, and the same horizon measure.
constant_dependencies.evidence: C may depend on c, T and S. All samples share the bound for t≤T. TimeMeasure.upTo T has support [0,T] and no endpoint atom.
